steps.caption: Every question you want to practise, kept in one bank

steps.text: Tell me about a time you missed a deadline.
steps.caption: Add them by hand — you choose what you get asked
It lands in the bank straight away
A session draws on whichever of them you tick
Take the lot, or cut it down to what you are weak on
The room runs it like a call: one question at a time
Answer out loud, or switch to typing

steps.text: I underestimated a data migration, and said so the week I knew.

steps.caption: Hand the turn back and it moves on
Afterwards it scores what you actually said
Five STAR-L pillars, weighted — the shape says what let you down
Then a card per answer: what was strongest, what to change
And a square for every day you sit in the hot seat
Which is the only part that actually makes you better
